title: Unfamiliar card purchase (fictional)
text: I reviewed my fictional card statement and found a $42.18 purchase at Example Market dated May 3. I did not make this purchase. I contacted the card company on May 8, but it still appears on my statement. I want the charge investigated and removed if it is not mine.

title: Annual fee after cancellation (fictional)
text: I closed my fictional credit card account in February. An annual fee appeared on my March statement, and a late fee was added after I disputed it. I called customer service twice. I am asking for both fees to be reviewed and removed.

title: Payment not reflected (fictional)
text: I paid $125 toward my fictional credit card on June 10 using the company's website. The payment was withdrawn from my bank, but the card balance still shows that I missed a payment. I contacted support on June 15 and want the payment credited to my account.

title: Account closure request (fictional)
text: I asked the company to close my fictional card account on April 2. I received a confirmation email, but the account still appears open in the mobile app. I want written confirmation that the account has been closed.

title: Credit report detail (fictional)
text: My fictional credit report shows a late payment on a card account for January. I paid the statement balance before the due date and have a confirmation email. I disputed the entry with the card company on March 4 and want the inaccurate late payment corrected.

title: Unclear mixed issue (fictional)
text: I have a question about my fictional account. Something changed on my statement and I spoke with someone, but I do not remember what the charge was or when it happened. I am not sure whether I want the account closed or the charge reviewed.
